name: orchestratormaxxing
description: Codex workflows and lifecycle gates for the orchestratormaxxing orchestration harness.

interface.shortDescription: Planning, research, bounded workers and verified public contributions.
interface.longDescription: Plan with Astra, create research briefs and durable project plans, propose coherent product tasks, verify bounded workers, and prepare weekly public contributions with explicit security gates.
defaultPrompt: For a broad or multi-deliverable request, use $orchestratormaxxing:gauntlet first to divide it into incremental parts; each part then follows normal routing.
Use $orchestratormaxxing:astraplan first for nontrivial unplanned work.
After root review, use $orchestratormaxxing:fanout only for independent implementation chunks.
Use omaxxing-public-improve and public-improve-security for validated public capability contributions.
